verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5090 is a graphics card. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in MCP servers and calls their tools is a software-agent role, so this story is a category error for a GPU. Nothing in the evidence shows the card, or software that ships as part of it, acting as an MCP client; the CUDA, DLSS and AI-acceleration material describes compute features, not tool-calling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
